external_datasets.title: Panasonic NCR18650B formation, full-cell RPT and harvested half-cell tests
external_datasets.cell_identity: Panasonic NCR18650B; HNEI study with full-cell labels NCRBxxx and harvested NE/PE half cells. Different specimens within one study, not an established half-cell-to-full-cell serial mapping.
external_datasets.rate_summary: The paper reports multi-rate full-cell charge/discharge characterization and half-cell RPT. Exact rate-to-MAT-step mapping was not read; a member named RPT is not a standalone equilibrium-OCP table.

channels.note: The paper describes voltage/capacity characterization against Li for harvested half cells. MAT fields, current/time/temperature columns, branch coordinates and reference conventions have not been inspected.

license.note: Zenodo API reports cc-zero; the record export identifies CC0 1.0. Publisher ZIP MD5 is retained, not independently recomputed. Only metadata and links are packaged.

review.note: Zenodo API/export license and file metadata, primary paper and complete ZIP central directory inspected. Three range requests read 20,604 directory bytes; no MAT member extracted. There are 158 MAT files (100 FORM, 56 full-cell RPT, two half-cell RPT), not 158 independent cells. Follow-up: selected half-cell/parameter originals were read, pinned and extracted by scripts/seed_parameter_sources.py. Full-cell observation payloads remain unread and external.

parameter_link.evidence: Native extracted OCP/parameter records and external full-cell tests are linked by explicit study/model identity. No identical serialized specimen is asserted.

external_datasets.title: Panasonic NCR18650B beginning-of-life pseudo-OCV, pulses and EIS (92 cells)
external_datasets.cell_identity: 92 Panasonic NCR18650B cells at beginning of life. Source rows identify individual cells within this dataset; no cross-study row/serial correspondence is established.
external_datasets.rate_summary: Whole-cell pseudo-OCV at 0.05C in both directions; 0.5C, 10 s charge/discharge pulses at 50% SOC. A single pulse rate is not a multi-rate continuous CC sweep.

channels.note: Field names/units are documented on the source page, not verified from CSV/MAT contents. Pseudo-OCV curves are interpolated to 5000 SOC points. EIS: 50% SOC, four-hour rest, 250 mA excitation, 0.01 Hz–10 kHz. Pulses follow two-hour rest. 25 degC is a chamber condition, not a measured temperature trace; no pulse current trace is claimed.

external_datasets.title: Panasonic NCR18650B ageing and repeated reference tests (116 cells)
external_datasets.cell_identity: 116 Panasonic NCR18650B 3.25 Ah cells in the Virtual Vehicle study. Source file stems are cell IDs; they do not identify cells in other NCR18650B studies.
external_datasets.rate_summary: 37 source-reported ageing load profiles plus repeated reference tests. RTP includes C/3 and 1C discharges, C/3 and C/2 CCCV charges and pulse sequences. Ageing-profile rates vary by cell; no complete same-state multi-rate characterization matrix is asserted.

channels.note: Fields are described in the author PDF; HDF5 groups, units, time axes and actual raw headers were not read. Initial RTPs use 5/15/25/35/45 degC; subsequent RTPs use 25 degC. Ageing-load temperatures differ (Table 2); source labels are not measured temperature extrema.

license.note: CC BY 4.0 is stated in Zenodo metadata/export. Retain author attribution and this DOI. Publisher file MD5 values identify external objects; no HDF5 checksum independently verified or data redistributed.

review.note: Complete Zenodo file metadata (116 H5 plus one PDF) and author PDF text reviewed; Table 2 and RTP page visually checked. No H5 observations read. Experiment ends at 70% remaining capacity or project end, so not every cell is certified to reach EOL.

parameter_link.evidence: Explicit Panasonic NCR18650B identity permits a cross-study reference to HNEI half-cell curves. No shared specimen, batch, ageing state or transferable D/kinetics is established.

missing_items: No electrode OCP, intrinsic diffusion or kinetic-law parameter association to the current catalog.
No H5 content inspection: group names, time axes, units, column coverage, cycle counts and payload checksums are not verified.

Table 2 reuses cell IDs 2_013/2_014/2_015 across distinct profile rows (L35/L26 and L205); L221 prints 2_57 rather than the listed 2_057.h5. No authoritative per-cell profile map is imported or silently corrected.
The stopping rule permits project-end censoring; do not label every cell as measured through EOL.
No named US06 or EIS measurement file identified. Pulse resistance is not EIS.
The other NCR18650B deposits share a commercial model only, not a verified study, batch, state of health or specimen.
